shots.x: He does not wait for her to climb. He takes her up in front of every king there and sets her beside him; her foot leaves the ground.
The chariot goes through the ring of kings the way a lion goes through jackals, and Balarama's men open the road in front of it.
From the moving chariot, he says the only thing he says in this trailer, to the kings he is leaving behind.
shots.dlg: Krishna: Kings — she walked out on her own feet. I am only the chariot.
shots.te: రాజులారా — ఆమె తన కాళ్లతోనే నడిచి వచ్చింది. నేను కేవలం రథాన్ని.

shots.x: The kings draw their swords too late. Behind the chariot a hundred horses turn at once.
The conch, sounded once — and the trailer cuts to black on it.
